name: hiring_backend
description: Backend pro onboarding a karierní portál

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run arch:check && npm run arch:module-shape && npm run arch:governance && npm run openapi:check
scripts.arch:governance: npm run arch:boundaries && npm run arch:coupling
scripts.arch:graph: mkdir -p reports/dependency && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs src --output-type json > reports/dependency/full.json && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs src --output-type mermaid > reports/dependency/full.mmd
scripts.arch:graph:applicants: mkdir -p reports/dependency && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only "src/(controllers|services|repositories|domain)/.*applicants" src --output-type json > reports/dependency/applicants.json && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only "src/(controllers|services|repositories|domain)/.*applicants" src --output-type mermaid > reports/dependency/applicants.mmd
scripts.arch:graph:calendar: mkdir -p reports/dependency && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only "src/(controllers|services|repositories|domain)/.*(calendar|interview)" src --output-type json > reports/dependency/calendar.json && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only "src/(controllers|services|repositories|domain)/.*(calendar|interview)" src --output-type mermaid > reports/dependency/calendar.mmd
scripts.arch:graph:employees: mkdir -p reports/dependency && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only "src/(controllers|services|repositories|domain)/.*employees" src --output-type json > reports/dependency/employees.json && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only "src/(controllers|services|repositories|domain)/.*employees" src --output-type mermaid > reports/dependency/employees.mmd
scripts.arch:graph:focus: npm run arch:graph:applicants && npm run arch:graph:calendar && npm run arch:graph:employees

author: Pavel Vácha
